name: Spain-based full-stack contractor filling the next engagement

context.geography: Spain, remote engagements with European clients
context.company_awareness: Knows some product companies but finds contracts through specialist recruiters and personal contacts.

trigger: A client confirms the current project will end in six weeks, leaving a finite window to find another paid engagement.

searches_run.query: remote full stack developer B2B contract Europe 3 months day rate
searches_run.observation: Retrieved specialist recruiter postings, LinkedIn and contract boards with duration and rate terms. The directly opened Foxley Talent result was explicitly closed, despite appearing relevant in search.

searches_run.query: freelance developer remote Europe contract jobs alerts day rate Spain
searches_run.observation: Retrieval included a Europe contract-board page with country filters and alert/save controls, plus remote-contract aggregators. Several other results were UK-only remote or longer engagements, illustrating geography and duration checks.

sources.title: Full Stack Developer Contract/Freelance | Foxley Talent
sources.supports: Directly inspected closed posting clearly states three-month duration, hourly rate, Europe/UK remote restriction and near-term start; example of useful fields, not a live opportunity.

sources.title: Senior Software Engineer | Signify Technology
sources.supports: Retrieved snippet states Contract B2B, EU-based applicants and daily rate; not independently verified as available.

sources.title: Contract and freelance roles in Europe | TopRoles
sources.supports: Retrieved page advertises country filters, contract listings, rate terms and alert/save controls.

sources.title: Senior Full Stack Developer three-month contractors | Acquire on LinkedIn
sources.supports: Retrieved snippet specifies remote within UK, demonstrating that remote does not imply Spain eligibility.

best_entry_page.primary_query: remote full stack developer B2B contract Europe 3 months day rate
best_entry_page.promise: No dedicated acquisition promise until current B2B inventory, Spain compatibility, rate units and contract duration can be demonstrated.
best_entry_page.cta: Use free employment-type, work-mode and technology filters to assess existing inventory before subscribing.
proof_needed: Count and sample current B2B engagements from covered sources
Separate fixed-term employment from business-to-business contracts
Preserve hourly/day rates and currency without silently annualising them
Explicit Spain or EU remote scope
Current close-status handling and usable duration/start-date evidence

conversion_objections: Most company career pages may offer permanent jobs.
My next engagement may be advertised only by a recruiter.
Contract can mean fixed-term employment rather than B2B.
An annual salary filter is not a day-rate filter.
I need an immediate pipeline, not occasional alerts from favorite companies.

avoid_targeting.reason: Tax/legal setup is outside the product and this research.
No marketplace, client matching or guaranteed work is demonstrated.

message_to_founder: Simulation: My unit of choice is an engagement with a rate, duration and start date, not an employer I admire. Show enough current contracts I can actually perform from Spain before selling me a monitoring subscription; otherwise my specialist recruiters remain more useful.

Source claims and role availability can change; product fit uses the supplied repository brief.
